a.text: I'm being upfront: I plan to take 4 in round 1, which breaks our agreement. With an 80% storm chance after every round, waiting to reach 8 means we both almost certainly die (about 4% chance to get there). The reserve holds only 4, enough for one of us right now. If we both take, the split is random and we could both end below 4. I'm telling you my move openly so you can plan around it rather than be surprised.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.
